verdict.rationale: Docs confirm balance accounts hold and split funds, support holding until payout, and provide reconciliation reports (docs-2, docs-5, docs-9), giving some visibility into where in-flight/held funds sit. However, there is no explicit statement about fund segregation from Adyen's own corporate accounts (e.g., safeguarding/trust account language) nor any mention of whether balances earn yield/interest. Missing for 10: explicit fund segregation/safeguarding disclosure, yield/interest policy on held balances, and independent confirmation of these practices.
